actions.name: 侧卧开书式转胸
actions.phase_zh: 侧卧双膝叠放、头枕支撑，上侧手向身后打开的转胸阶段。
actions.pose: Open-book thoracic rotation on a neutral-gray non-slip exercise mat. Elevated oblique three-quarter view from in front, with the entire woman's body, head pillow, both arms/hands and both knees/feet clearly visible with margins. She lies on her RIGHT side, hips and knees comfortably bent about 80–90 degrees and stacked together with a thin gray pillow between knees; both knees remain TOGETHER on mat without opening or rolling pelvis. Head rests naturally on a small neutral-gray pillow, neck comfortable. Lower RIGHT arm stays straight out forward in front of chest at shoulder height, palm up resting on mat. Upper LEFT arm opens slowly backwards to the opposite side of her body at about shoulder height, elbow softly extended and hand floating comfortably a little above mat, showing gentle OPEN BOOK thoracic rotation. Her chest opens gently upward toward camera while pelvis and stacked bent knees stay on their side, NOT a supine knee-roll pose. Eyes may follow opening upper hand, no forced neck twist. No forcing upper hand to ground, no pulling knees, no pelvic weights. White socks without shoes. One gentle open phase, no duplicate person, no arrows. Normal adult limb length and proportions, no obscured or cropped hands.
